**Chaudhary Ijaz Ahmed Warraich** is a Pakistani politician who served as the Chairman of the Union Council of Jalalpur Jattan, Gujrat District twice during the 1990s. He is recognized as a notable personality in the region due to his contributions to local development and public service.
## Political Career
Chaudhary Ijaz Ahmed Warraich played a significant role in the political landscape of Jalalpur Jattan, Gujrat District. He was elected as the Union Council Chairman twice, reflecting his strong support among the local community. His tenure was marked by various initiatives aimed at improving infrastructure, education, and public welfare.
## Contributions and Development Work
During his time in office, Warraich was instrumental in launching numerous development projects. These included improvements to road networks, enhancements in the local education system, and initiatives for better healthcare facilities. His efforts contributed to the socio-economic uplift of the region, earning him respect and recognition from the local populace.

As a respected figure in Jalalpur Jattan, Gujrat District, Chaudhary Ijaz Ahmed Warraich continues to be regarded as a key contributor to the area’s development. His leadership and dedication to public service have left a lasting impact on the community, inspiring future generations of political leaders and activists.
